summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated infrastructure for the full model lifecycle — data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, deployment, and monitoring — at scale. You need one when you're building custom or fine-tuned models, require governance, reproducibility, and MLOps across teams, or must manage large-scale training and serving infrastructure; by contrast, a simple model API (like OpenAI or Anthropic) suffices when you only need inference from a pre-trained model without owning the training or deployment pipeline. The market is led by the three hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) with Databricks as a strong multi-cloud challenger, followed by specialized AutoML and MLOps tools.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage usage; no upfront fees, charged per instance-hour for notebooks, training, and endpoints
platforms.best_for: AWS-native enterprises wanting a comprehensive, service-oriented ML platform tightly integrated with the AWS ecosystem

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/node usage, training hours, and prediction requests; generative AI priced per token
platforms.best_for: Teams on Google Cloud wanting unified AutoML plus access to Gemini and foundation models via Model Garden

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute usage; no surcharge on top of underlying Azure VM/compute costs
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-centric enterprises needing enterprise governance, responsible AI tooling, and Azure OpenAI integration

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based pricing via Databricks Units (DBUs) plus underlying cloud compute costs
platforms.best_for: Data-centric organizations unifying data lakehouse, analytics, and ML across multiple clouds

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; subscription per-seat/usage for teams and enterprise plans
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration layered on any training stack

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated model building and deployment with strong governance and minimal ML coding

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core (H2O-3) free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting open-source-rooted AutoML with strong explainability and flexible deployment options

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based, per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting Python-native serverless infrastructure to run and deploy ML/AI workloads without managing servers

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription, usage-based Inference Endpoints, and enterprise plans
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source transformer and foundation models with easy access to pretrained models and inference

platforms.name: Vertex AI / SageMaker-adjacent: ClearML
platforms.pricing: Open-source free tier; paid Pro and enterprise tiers by usage/seats
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open-source, end-to-end MLOps stack combining experiment tracking and orchestration
